summary: Fourteen of the seventeen seeded convergence worlds run in the daily run only (about 265 test-s per pull request on a build host). Pull requests keep seeds 1, 2 and 34, the real-disk seed_1 run and the suite's own checks; the daily run still runs all seventeen. Approved by Nathan.

replay.detail: Test selection only; no claim, replay or projection change.

rules.detail: No rule, permission or trust change.

compatibility.detail: No wire, CLI or client change.

downtime.detail: Nothing runs differently on installed machines.

recovery.detail: Remove the convergence line from .config/daily-only.filterset to run every seed on pull requests again.
